title: Adding Custom GBIF Datasets
description: Guide on how to export, configure, and ingest custom DarwinCore occurrence datasets directly from GBIF.org.

steps.title: Navigate to GBIF Occurrences Search
steps.description: Open GBIF.org in your web browser, navigate to the desired dataset search, and click 'Occurrences' in the top main navigation menu.

steps.title: Filter Target Area and Taxa
steps.description: Apply filters for your target geographic region, seasonality, or taxonomic groups. Keeping dataset size under 1,000,000 observations is recommended for desktop performance.

steps.title: Select DarwinCore Archive Download
steps.description: Select the 'Download' tab, choose 'DarwinCore Archive', and click 'Configure' to open archive export options.

steps.title: Locate Multimedia Extension
steps.description: In the archive configuration panel, scroll down to locate the 'Format' section and the 'Multimedia' extension list.

steps.title: Enable Multimedia Extension
steps.description: Select the 'Multimedia' extension checkbox (required for field photo URLs) and click 'Continue to Terms'.

steps.title: Acknowledge Terms & Create Download
steps.description: Review the GBIF Data License terms (CC BY 4.0), check the agreement box, and click 'Create Download'. GBIF will prepare the export archive.

steps.title: Copy Archive Download Link
steps.description: Once the export is ready, right-click the 'Download archive' button and select 'Copy link address' to copy the direct ZIP download URL to your clipboard.

steps.title: Clear Current Data Source (Optional)
steps.description: In Taxo-Trainer, open 'Settings & Data' tab. If replacing an existing dataset, click 'Clear current data source' to purge previous records.

steps.title: Import Archive & Enrich Names
steps.description: Paste the copied ZIP URL into the DwC Ingestion input box and click 'Start Ingestion'. Afterward, click 'Fetch Danish Names from GBIF API' to enrich common names.
